decision.overall_recommendation: VIX gate is open, so new entries are permissible, but this batch skews heavily toward reversion_bounce/downtrend setups with only a handful of clean trend_continuation names, and several candidates carry real fundamental red flags (insider selling, targets being cut, or outright still-falling price action) that outweigh clean chart geometry. Favor the top-ranked names (PVH, CECO, SOLS, ADEA, PTRN) where research genuinely supports the technical setup, size conservatively, and treat the five still_falling names (KIM, FNB, TEX, AROC, MDU) as do-not-touch regardless of their fundamentals. Sector concentration is a real constraint here: Real Estate and Industrials are both already represented in the existing Webull book, so multiple candidates in each sector will be capped by the pipeline's 3-per-sector rule — rely on the ranking order to determine which survive.
